#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, flow, rid, cost;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), rid(c), cost(d) {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    vector<Edge>* al;
    vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
    int* d;
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = numeric_limits<int>::max() / 100;
    int edges = 0;

    int* node;
    int* visit;
    int* prv;
    int* prve;
    int* dist;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        al = new vector<Edge>[N];
        d = new int[N];
        node = new int[N];
        visit = new int[N];
        prv = new int[N];
        prve = new int[N];
        dist = new int[N];
    }

    ~MinCostMaxFlow() {
        delete[] d;
        delete[] node;
        delete[] visit;
        delete[] prv;
        delete[] prve;
        delete[] dist;
        delete[] al;
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = (int)al[u].size();
        int lv = (int)al[v].size();
        al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, lv, cost));
        al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, lu, -cost));
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            ja[i] = al[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) d[i] = gmax;
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (auto& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                        d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (auto& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false; // negative cycle check
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool simple() {
        memset(node, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        memset(visit, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        memset(prv, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        memset(prve, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            dist[i] = gmax;
        }
        node[0] = S;
        dist[0] = 0;

        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        node[front++] = e.u;
                        if (front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    prv[e.u] = u;
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    struct Pair {
        int F, S;
        Pair(int a, int b): F(a), S(b) {}
        bool operator<(const Pair& other) const {
            return S > other.S; // for min-heap
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        memset(visit, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        memset(prv, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        memset(prve, 0, N * sizeof(int));
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) dist[i] = gmax;
        priority_queue<Pair> pq;
        pq.push(Pair(S, 0));
        dist[S] = 0;

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            Pair p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist[p.F] < p.S) continue;
            visit[p.F] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[p.F].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = ja[p.F][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = p.S + (e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u]);
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push(Pair(e.u, cdist));
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                    prv[e.u] = p.F;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T;
        int minFlow = gmax;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
            if (val < minFlow)
                minFlow = val;
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minFlow;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minFlow;
        return minFlow;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        // Uncomment to check for negative cycles
        // bool possible = BellmanFord(true);
        // if (!possible) return false;
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        // Set true to check for negative cycles
        // bool possible = BellmanFord(false);
        // if (!possible) return false;
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int min_val = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += min_val * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1, 0);
    vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (f[i] != 0) {
            ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        int aVal, bVal;
        cin >> aVal >> bVal;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                if (aVal != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + aVal, n * (l + 1) + bVal, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (bVal != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + bVal, n * (l + 1) + aVal, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; ++l) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }

    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();

    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << ans.minCost << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
